name: Dropbox
description: Dropbox's hosted server searches and reads files and folders in your account, so the agent can work from documents you already keep there.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (www.dropbox.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
